title: A Nemzeti hitvallás és a történelmi örökség (The National Avowal & Historical Heritage)
grammar: Constitutional Regimes, Rights Guarantees & Legal Terminology in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the National Avowal is and how it begins.
I can name some things the National Avowal says about Saint Stephen, the language and the nationalities.
I can use solemn phrases such as valljuk, hogy and elismerjük.
I can read a short text about the National Avowal and answer questions about it.
